_comment: World-side player-facing strings: examine prompts (the '[E] Examine' label) and examine bodies. Two-stage reveal pattern (LOCKED 2026-06-09, see docs/design/insight_revelation_system.md): tier-0 = pre-examine sensory framing (what the player sees from a distance with no insight); tier-1 = operational-understanding from having examined it (what it's DOING, observed; no cosmological vocabulary); tier-2 = the Guide's cosmological naming after he's fed the frame by Beatrice. Cosmology words (soul, imprint, dissolved, Acheron, sangue, etc.) belong at tier-2 ONLY. tier-1 is observational/functional language a person could derive from looking; tier-2 is what only a cosmologically-positioned NPC could name.
